vectors.intent_statement: Keep the measured repository inventory aligned with the newly registered career scope.
Ask the private plane to serve career profiles from Citadel Nexus stores and to bind the endpoint to BuildAndDo, without moving that data into the public repository.
Distinguish reviewed source fingerprints from execution or deployment evidence.
Preserve reviewer-runnable evidence that the career slice credits only attributed work and never infers reserved answers or submits.
Authorize and gate the local career evidence slice without discovery, submission or external-write authority.
Specify a local career evidence engine that derives role matches and application packages only from recorded work, with explicit participation and human-reserved attestations.
Name every SRS code a branch may claim, and where its spec lives.
Expose the career evidence engine's public entry points.
Allow `python -m apps.career` to run the local CLI.
Test an imported or claimed capability with timed, limited, re-gradable quizzes whose answers the candidate never receives.
Bound every application step by an explicit J0-J5 tier so answers a human must give are never inferred or auto-submitted.
Run the passport, match, dossier and package stages locally, writing only to a new output directory.
Compile an application package in which every claim traces to passport evidence and every reserved answer stays with the human.
Explain why a role fits, what to lead with and, mandatorily, what must not be claimed.
Keep who did the work and how it is known explicit, so a claim can never outgrow its evidence.
Map an employer form to package content field by field, so a runner can only type what the human approved and must stop where the human must answer.
Turn local git history into participation-classified evidence, crediting a person only for work they authored or integrated.
Bring skills, certifications, positions and badges from other platforms in as self-reported claims that an assessment can later upgrade.
Normalize supplied postings into canonical job entities and typed requirements the matcher can evaluate without guessing.
Give every append-only career record one hash chain, so an edited, removed or reordered line is detected on read.
Map each job requirement to the passport evidence that does or does not support it, instead of a single opaque score.
Admit BuildAndDo mission work into the passport, reaching VERIFIED only where a different person reviewed the run.
Record human-reported application outcomes and show which representations of real work get responses, without over-reading small samples.
Reload a written application package only when its bytes still match the digest the human approved.
Aggregate participation-classified evidence into a per-capability Career Passport that states its own limits.
Define the one profile envelope Citadel Nexus serves to BuildAndDo at login, so both sides validate the same shape.
Normalize public Lever, Greenhouse and Ashby job-board feeds into canonical jobs with read-only, opt-in fetching.
Name the capabilities both work evidence and job requirements resolve to, so matching compares like with like.
Let a recruiter or reviewer re-derive a passport's repository claims themselves, so a claim is checked against the work rather than taken on trust.

Fetch the signed-in user's career profile from Citadel Nexus server-to-server and return only an allow-listed, account-bound projection, storing nothing. BUILDANDDO_CAREER_PROFILE_URL    Citadel endpoint; https://, or http:// on loopback only. BUILDANDDO_CAREER_PROFILE_TOKEN  service bearer token; never sent to the browser.
Serve the signed-in user's Citadel-held career profile with native auth and no-store, so it loads at login and is never cached.
Mount the career profile provider so the Citadel-held profile loads when a user signs in.
Load the user's career profile from Citadel Nexus as soon as they sign in, and drop it the moment they sign out or switch account.
Prove the career profile loads when a user signs in and is cleared on sign-out, account change and demo mode.
Prove the browser accepts a career profile only for the signed-in account and in the expected shape.
Request the signed-in user's Citadel-held career profile and accept it only for that account, keeping it in memory.
Make the career tests importable as a package.
Require the career behavior suite and at least 80 percent measured statement coverage per module.
Prove imported claims stay self-reported until assessed, and that assessments are hidden-key, limited, timed and re-gradable.
Prove participation-honest attribution, requirement coverage, mandatory do-not-claim lists, reserved-answer handling and claim provenance.
Prove the login envelope binds one digest-checked passport to one account and carries nothing else.
Keep every adversarial failure found against the engine as a regression test: laundered agent work, bot identities, misread requirements, forged passports and edited ledgers.
Prove public-board normalization, mission verification rules, verified package reloads, the outcome ledger and fill-plan authority.
Provide a synthetic ashby public job-board payload covering extractable, empty and duplicate postings.
Provide synthetic Open Badges assertions: one issued to the test person by salted hash, one with a non-email recipient.
Provide a public sample question bank; real banks with answer keys stay with the grader.
Provide a synthetic employer form mixing profile, package, file and human-reserved fields.
Provide a synthetic greenhouse public job-board payload covering extractable, empty and duplicate postings.
Provide synthetic postings covering supported, partial, unmapped, tenure, credential and reserved requirements.
Provide a synthetic lever public job-board payload covering extractable, empty and duplicate postings.
Provide a synthetic mission export covering self-reported, independently reviewed, self-reviewed and others' runs.
Provide synthetic application questions mixing evidence-answerable and human-reserved classes.
Provide a synthetic JSON Resume with mapped and unmapped skills, a certificate and a position.
Run the real profile route against a Citadel double serving a Python-built envelope, proving auth, account binding, allow-listing, no-store and no persistence.
Provide a synthetic LinkedIn export with endorsements, a certification, overlapping positions and a CSV preamble.
